title.zh-TW: 註冊成功享 Let’s café 經典美式一杯
title.en: Classic Americano from Let's café when you sign up

text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: From the platform's share text; actual terms follow the official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟活動連結（會用外部瀏覽器開啟）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the campaign link (it opens in your external browser).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示完成註冊，必要時下載 App。
steps.en: Follow the page to register, and install the app if asked.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊成功後依活動規則領取咖啡；消費可賺 Fa 點。
steps.en: After registering, claim the coffee under the campaign rules; spending earns Fa points.

intro.zh-TW: 註冊全盈+PAY 成功即享 Let’s café 經典美式一杯，消費還能賺 Fa 點。
intro.en: Sign up for PLUS PAY to get a classic Americano from Let's café; spending also earns Fa points.

description.zh-TW:
全盈+PAY（PLUS PAY）是提供支付功能的服務，消費可累積 Fa 點。此連結不含另外的邀請碼，直接點擊「立即註冊」並依頁面指示完成註冊即可，不需要輸入任何代碼；連結會用外部瀏覽器開啟，必要時再下載 App。

依平台分享文案，註冊成功可獲贈 Let’s café 經典美式一杯，實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。填寫個人資料前，建議先確認網址的網域屬於官方。
description.en:
PLUS PAY (全盈+PAY) is a payment service where spending earns Fa points. The link on this page has no separate referral code, so there is nothing to type: select “Sign up”, follow the page to register, and install the app if you are asked to. The link opens in your external browser.

According to the platform's share text, registering successfully can get you a classic Americano from Let's café. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow the official announcements. Before you enter personal details, check that the address domain belongs to the platform.

notes.zh-TW: 此連結不含邀請碼，使用連結註冊即可；網址內的識別參數本站保持原樣，不做改寫。
notes.en: This link has no separate code; just sign up through it. The identifier in the address is kept unchanged by this site.
